roster.name: researcher
roster.about: search the web, find papers and specs, look up github repositories and facts, licenses and versions; answer whether an approach or setting is a good idea

roster.name: reviewer
roster.about: review, critique, and poke holes in code, patches, pull requests, scripts, and written work — READMEs, design docs, API design, error-message wording; look over or sanity-check something before it runs, flag style problems, and point out gaps in test coverage; be a second pair of eyes on a diff

roster.name: deployer
roster.about: deploy, ship, release, roll out, and promote builds to production with docker
